gold: Lightning-induced retinopathy with delayed-onset cystoid macular abnormalities

selector.rationale: Traumatic maculopathy best explains the central macular thickening, cystoid changes, and subfoveal ellipsoid zone disruption seen in the fundus examination and OCT findings after the lightning strike.

rejected.label: Electrical injury to the eye
rejected.why: Too broad, does not specifically explain the macular findings

rejected.label: Cystoid macular edema
rejected.why: Only partially explains the findings, does not account for the full range of traumatic changes

rejected.label: Lightning-induced cataract
rejected.why: Only explains the cataract development, does not account for the macular changes
